summary: Full backend + frontend testing of GetSpot social discovery app. 15/15 backend pytest tests passed (me, stories, events list/detail/filter/going-toggle/create, spots list/filter, posts, chats, messages send). Frontend tested on 375x800 mobile viewport: Discover greeting + stories(5) + events(6) + tab bar(5) all render, Wellness filter works (1 event), Going toggle works ('Going' -> 'Going ✓') when not occluded by tab bar. Map tab shows 8 nearby spots + Top Spots -> /spots navigation + Bars filter (2 spots) works. Chats tab shows 5 chats, navigates to /chat/c1, message send works (bubble appears). Profile tab has avatar/settings/segments/feed grid. Settings screen has Pause notifications toggle, Dark mode, Language, Log Out. Create FAB opens modal with 3 options; Create Event form submits and new event appears at top of Discover. Event detail /event/e1 shows hero, host card, date/location, attendees, About, 'I'm Going' bottom action bar. All testIDs from spec are present and working.

ui_bugs.issue: FloatingTabBar (~80px tall) overlaps the bottom of the first event card on standard 375x667 viewport, partially occluding the 'Next time' / 'Going' action buttons. Tap still works when scrolled, but on small devices users may struggle to interact without scrolling. Suggest adding bottom padding/margin to the ScrollView contentContainerStyle equal to tab bar height + 16px (currently 140, may need to increase or ensure first card has more top padding).

issues: First event card 'Going' / 'Next time' buttons sit behind the floating tab bar at default viewport height; ensure adequate bottom safe-area padding so primary CTAs are not partially covered.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but worth migrating for future RN compatibility.

action_items: Optional: Increase bottom padding on Discover ScrollView so the first event card's action buttons are not occluded by the FloatingTabBar on short viewports (375x667).
Optional: Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents to silence RN web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: in-memory state is module-scoped — tests mutate EVENTS (create) and CHATS (send message) and state persists across tests/sessions. Acceptable for MVP demo but document/reset between sessions if needed.

server.py /api/events category filter uses an exclusion list ('all', 'upcoming', 'past', 'trending') and treats them all as 'no filter'. This is intentional but means category='Upcoming' silently returns full list — acceptable per spec but slightly ambiguous.
All endpoints follow Pydantic validation and return clean JSON (no MongoDB _id leakage since storage is in-memory).
EventCard correctly toggles label between 'Going' and 'Going ✓' based on event.going state — integration verified end-to-end.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all spec'd flows functional; minor UI overlap issue on Discover bottom CTAs)

seed_data_creation: None beyond what backend seeds itself. Pytest created one 'TEST_Event_Pytest' event and 'TEST_pytest hello' message; in-memory storage means they reset on backend restart.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All testIDs documented in spec are implemented (kebab-case). Use mobile viewport 375x800 (NOT 667) to interact with first event card's CTAs without tab-bar occlusion. Backend is in-memory — state persists until backend restart. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://glass-discovery-1.preview.emergentagent.com with /api prefix.
rca_of_issue: Initial frontend test on 375x667 viewport showed Going toggle did not change label. RCA: FloatingTabBar overlay covered the button at the bottom of the viewport; click event was intercepted (no POST /api/events/.../going hit backend). Mitigation in test: use 375x800 viewport + scroll so button is centered. Real product fix recommendation: bump bottom padding on Discover ScrollView (currently paddingBottom: 140) or shift content above floating tab bar.
